Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075189' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
